# Overview

This R Markdown document performs the Part B elastic-net feature selection and narrowing analysis for the capsule sponge copy-number study. The script derives robust genomic predictors from arm-level relative copy number (RCN) using elastic-net logistic regression, data-driven alpha/lambda selection, leave-one-out robustness evaluation, and effect-size stability metrics.

## Data requirements

This analysis requires participant-derived sequencing and clinical data that are
not distributed with this public code repository. Instructions for obtaining the
controlled-access datasets are provided in `data/README.md`.

This script also requires `results/capsulesponge_gw_burden_df.rds`, which is
generated by first running `scripts/capsule_sponge_resubmission_analysis.Rmd`.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

set.seed(123)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(caret)
  library(glmnet)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(scales)
})
```

# 0. Define project structure

```{r project-structure}
# Folder containing cleaned input files
input_dir <- "data"

# Folder containing outputs from Part A
part_a_results_dir <- "results"

# Folder for all Part B outputs
output_dir <- file.path("results", "elastic_net_model")

dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Capsule sponge 50 kb segmented copy-number data
cytosponge_segmented_file <- file.path(
  input_dir,
  "capsule_sponge_50kb_segmented.tsv"
)

clinical_file <- file.path(input_dir, "clinical_metadata.tsv")
gw_burden_file <- file.path(part_a_results_dir, "capsulesponge_gw_burden_df.rds")

required_input_files <- c(
  cytosponge_segmented_file,
  clinical_file,
  gw_burden_file
)

missing_input_files <- required_input_files[!file.exists(required_input_files)]

if (length(missing_input_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required input files are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_input_files, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nRun Part A first and check that the cleaned input files are in the expected folders."
  )
}

cat("Using segmented file:\n", cytosponge_segmented_file, "\n")
cat("Using clinical file:\n", clinical_file, "\n")
cat("Using GW-CNA burden file from Part A:\n", gw_burden_file, "\n")
```

# 1. Import data and construct arm-level median RCN matrix

```{r import-and-arm-level-matrix}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.1 Load cleaned capsule sponge segmented 50 kb data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

sponge_CN_50kb_raw <- readr::read_tsv(
  cytosponge_segmented_file,
  col_types = cols()
) %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = as.character(chromosomal_arm),
    chromosomal_arm = if_else(
      stringr::str_starts(chromosomal_arm, "chr"),
      chromosomal_arm,
      paste0("chr", chromosomal_arm)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(chromosome)

cat("\nSegmented copy-number data dimensions:\n")
print(dim(sponge_CN_50kb_raw))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.2 Convert wide sample columns to long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

arm_rcn_long <- sponge_CN_50kb_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^SLX"),
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "segmented_CN"
  )

cat("\nLong-format copy-number data dimensions:\n")
print(dim(arm_rcn_long))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.3 Load cleaned clinical metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

clinical <- readr::read_tsv(
  clinical_file,
  col_types = cols()
)

cat("\nClinical metadata dimensions:\n")
print(dim(clinical))

cat("\nClinical metadata columns:\n")
print(colnames(clinical))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.4 Load GW-CNA burden generated by Part A
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cna_burden <- readRDS(gw_burden_file)

# Harmonise older/newer burden column names without changing values.
if ("genomewide_CNA_burden" %in% names(cna_burden) &&
    !"genome_wide_CNA_burden" %in% names(cna_burden)) {
  cna_burden <- cna_burden %>%
    rename(genome_wide_CNA_burden = genomewide_CNA_burden)
}

cna_burden <- cna_burden %>%
  dplyr::select(
    specimen_ID,
    genome_wide_CNA_burden,
    any_of(c("genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary", "outcome_tri_category"))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

cat("\nGW-CNA burden data dimensions:\n")
print(dim(cna_burden))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.5 Join clinical metadata and GW-CNA burden
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

clinical_full <- inner_join(
  clinical,
  cna_burden,
  by = "specimen_ID"
)

cat("\nClinical metadata after joining GW-CNA burden:\n")
print(dim(clinical_full))

cat("\nClinical + GW-CNA columns:\n")
print(colnames(clinical_full))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.6 Collapse 50 kb values to specimen-level median per chromosome arm
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

arm_median <- arm_rcn_long %>%
  aggregate(
    segmented_CN ~ sample_id + chromosomal_arm,
    FUN = median
  )

cat("\nArm-level median RCN dimensions:\n")
print(dim(arm_median))
```

# 2. Construct modelling dataset

```{r construct-model-input}
arm_order <- c(
  "chr1p", "chr1q",
  "chr2p", "chr2q",
  "chr3p", "chr3q",
  "chr4p", "chr4q",
  "chr5p", "chr5q",
  "chr6p", "chr6q",
  "chr7p", "chr7q",
  "chr8p", "chr8q",
  "chr9p", "chr9q",
  "chr10p", "chr10q",
  "chr11p", "chr11q",
  "chr12p", "chr12q",
  "chr13q",
  "chr14q",
  "chr15q",
  "chr16p", "chr16q",
  "chr17p", "chr17q",
  "chr18p", "chr18q",
  "chr19p", "chr19q",
  "chr20p", "chr20q",
  "chr21q",
  "chr22q"
)

model_input <- arm_median %>%
  inner_join(
    clinical_full,
    by = c("sample_id" = "sequencing_ID")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = chromosomal_arm,
    values_from = segmented_CN
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    specimen_ID,
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized,
    all_of(arm_order),
    genome_wide_CNA_burden
  )

print(dim(model_input))

cat("\nModel input columns:\n")
print(colnames(model_input))

cat("\nOutcome counts in model input:\n")
print(table(model_input$endoscopy_outcome_binarized, useNA = "ifany"))

# Save input table for transparency
write_tsv(
  model_input,
  file.path(output_dir, "model_input_armRCN_plus_genomewideCNAburden.tsv")
)
```

# 3. Prepare predictor and outcome matrices

```{r prepare-predictor-outcome-matrices}
set.seed(123)

data_mat <- model_input %>%
  column_to_rownames("specimen_ID")

data_mat$endoscopy_outcome_binarized <- as.factor(data_mat$endoscopy_outcome_binarized)

data_mat <- data_mat[
  c(
    setdiff(names(data_mat), "endoscopy_outcome_binarized"),
    "endoscopy_outcome_binarized"
  )
]

x <- model.matrix(endoscopy_outcome_binarized ~ ., data = data_mat)[, -1]
y <- data_mat$endoscopy_outcome_binarized

cat("\nPredictor matrix dimensions:\n")
print(dim(x))

cat("\nOutcome counts:\n")
print(table(y, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# 4. Grid search for alpha

```{r alpha-grid-search}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grid search for alpha in [0,1] using step 0.1.
# For each alpha, the  script uses 10 runs of 5-fold CV.
# Accuracy and sparsity are estimated at lambda.1se.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

alpha_values <- seq(0, 1, 0.1)
cv_results <- tibble()

for (alpha_val in alpha_values) {
  for (i in 1:10) {
    set.seed(123 + i)

    folds <- caret::createFolds(
      y,
      k = 5,
      list = TRUE,
      returnTrain = TRUE
    )

    fold_acc <- c()
    fold_nz  <- c()
    fold_lam <- c()

    for (fold in folds) {
      train_x <- x[fold, ]
      train_y <- y[fold]

      cv_fit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
        train_x,
        train_y,
        alpha = alpha_val,
        family = "binomial",
        type.measure = "class"
      )

      fold_acc <- c(
        fold_acc,
        1 - cv_fit$cvm[which.min(cv_fit$cvm)]
      )

      fold_nz <- c(
        fold_nz,
        sum(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.1se")[-1] != 0)
      )

      fold_lam <- c(
        fold_lam,
        cv_fit$lambda.1se
      )
    }

    cv_results <- bind_rows(
      cv_results,
      tibble(
        alpha = alpha_val,
        run = i,
        accuracy = mean(fold_acc),
        nonzero = mean(fold_nz),
        lambda_1se = mean(fold_lam)
      )
    )
  }
}

cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  group_by(alpha) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
    mean_nonzero = mean(nonzero),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nCross-validation summary by alpha:\n")
print(cv_summary, n = Inf)

write_tsv(
  cv_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "cv_results_all_runs.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  cv_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "cv_summary_by_alpha.tsv")
)
```

# 5. Select alpha and lambda

```{r select-alpha-lambda}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Selection rule:
# - alpha: accuracy plateau within 0.2 percentage points of best mean accuracy,
#   followed by median sparsity within the plateau.
# - lambda.1se: composite of accuracy and sparsity.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

tolerance <- 0.002

plateau <- cv_summary %>%
  filter(mean_accuracy >= max(mean_accuracy) - tolerance)

best_alpha <- plateau %>%
  arrange(mean_nonzero) %>%
  slice(round(n() / 2)) %>%
  pull(alpha)

lambda_choice <- cv_results %>%
  filter(alpha == best_alpha) %>%
  mutate(
    score = 0.5 * accuracy +
      0.5 * (1 - (nonzero / max(nonzero)))
  ) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = score, n = 1)

best_lambda <- lambda_choice$lambda_1se

cat(
  "Selected alpha =", best_alpha,
  " | Selected lambda.1se =", round(best_lambda, 5),
  "\n"
)

write_tsv(
  tibble(
    best_alpha = best_alpha,
    best_lambda = best_lambda
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_alpha_lambda.tsv")
)
```

# 6. Leave-one-out robustness at fixed alpha and lambda

```{r loo-robustness}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Retain predictors non-zero in at least 70% of refits and with consistent sign.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

n <- nrow(x)
sample_ids <- rownames(x)

nz_list <- vector("list", n)
pred_list <- vector("list", n)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
    x[-i, ],
    y[-i],
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = best_alpha,
    lambda = best_lambda,
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  coefs <- coef(fit)

  nz <- tibble(
    feature = rownames(coefs)[coefs[, 1] != 0],
    value = as.numeric(coefs[coefs[, 1] != 0])
  ) %>%
    filter(feature != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(sample_id = sample_ids[i])

  nz_list[[i]] <- nz

  pred <- predict(
    fit,
    newx = x[i, , drop = FALSE],
    type = "response"
  )[, 1]

  pred_list[[i]] <- tibble(
    sample_id = sample_ids[i],
    observed = y[i],
    predicted_prob = pred
  )
}

coeff_loo <- bind_rows(nz_list)
pred_loo <- bind_rows(pred_list)

write_tsv(
  coeff_loo,
  file.path(output_dir, "loo_nonzero_coefficients.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  pred_loo,
  file.path(output_dir, "loo_predictions.tsv")
)

robustness <- coeff_loo %>%
  count(feature, name = "n_refits") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_refits = 100 * n_refits / nrow(x)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    coeff_loo %>%
      group_by(feature) %>%
      summarise(
        sign_consistent = max(mean(value > 0), mean(value < 0)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_refits))

robust_features <- robustness %>%
  filter(
    pct_refits >= 70,
    sign_consistent >= 0.7
  ) %>%
  pull(feature)

cat("\nFeature robustness summary:\n")
print(robustness, n = Inf)

cat("\nRobust features:\n")
print(robust_features)

write_tsv(
  robustness,
  file.path(output_dir, "feature_robustness.tsv")
)
```

# 7. Fit final model and extract non-zero coefficients

```{r final-model-coefficients}
final_fit <- glmnet::glmnet(
  x,
  y,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = best_alpha,
  lambda = best_lambda,
  standardize = TRUE
)

coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(final_fit$beta)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("feature") %>%
  rename(beta = s0) %>%
  filter(beta != 0)

cat("\nFinal non-zero coefficients:\n")
print(coef_df)

write_tsv(
  coef_df,
  file.path(output_dir, "final_coefficients.tsv")
)
```

# 8. Quantify effect-size stability using cvRR

```{r cvrr}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For each specimen, compute exp(feature_value * beta_feature).
# cvRR = sd / mean of these relative risks across specimens.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

beta_vec <- coef_df$beta[match(colnames(x), coef_df$feature)]
beta_vec[is.na(beta_vec)] <- 0
names(beta_vec) <- colnames(x)

exp_rr <- exp(
  sweep(
    as.data.frame(x),
    2,
    beta_vec,
    `*`
  )
)

cvRR <- sapply(
  exp_rr,
  function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
)

cvRR_df <- tibble(
  feature = names(cvRR),
  cvRR = as.numeric(cvRR)
)

cat("\ncvRR values:\n")
print(cvRR_df, n = Inf)

write_tsv(
  cvRR_df,
  file.path(output_dir, "cvRR_values.tsv")
)
```

# 9. Objective narrowing using composite score

```{r composite-score}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Original rule:
# Normalize |beta| and cvRR to 0-1, calculate a 50:50 composite score,
# and define top-quartile features as priority predictors.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

feature_scores <- coef_df %>%
  inner_join(cvRR_df, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(
    abs_beta = abs(beta),
    norm_beta = scales::rescale(abs_beta, to = c(0, 1)),
    norm_cvRR = scales::rescale(cvRR, to = c(0, 1)),
    composite_score = 0.5 * norm_beta + 0.5 * norm_cvRR,
    top_quartile = composite_score >= quantile(composite_score, 0.75)
  )

cat("\nFeature composite scores:\n")
print(feature_scores)

write_tsv(
  feature_scores,
  file.path(output_dir, "feature_composite_scores.tsv")
)
```

# 10. Define final fixed genomic panel

```{r final-panel}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Original rule:
# Fixed panel = features that are robust in LOO refits and top-quartile by
# composite score.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_panel <- feature_scores %>%
  filter(
    feature %in% robust_features,
    top_quartile
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(composite_score)) %>%
  pull(feature)

write_tsv(
  tibble(final_panel = final_panel),
  file.path(output_dir, "final_fixed_genomic_panel.tsv")
)

cat("\nFinal fixed genomic panel:\n")
cat(paste(final_panel, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 11. Visualisation

```{r visualisation}
p_beta <- ggplot(
  coef_df,
  aes(
    x = beta,
    y = reorder(feature, beta)
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2b8cbe") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "grey50",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient (beta)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Elastic-net coefficients"
  ) +
  theme_pubr(base_size = 14)

print(p_beta)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "plot_coefficients.pdf"),
  p_beta,
  width = 6,
  height = 6
)

p_comp <- ggplot(
  feature_scores,
  aes(
    x = norm_cvRR,
    y = norm_beta,
    size = composite_score,
    color = top_quartile,
    label = feature
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      `TRUE` = "#08306b",
      `FALSE` = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Normalized cvRR (stability)",
    y = "Normalized |beta| (effect size)",
    color = "Top quartile",
    size = "Composite score",
    title = "Composite feature prioritization"
  ) +
  theme_pubr(base_size = 14)

print(p_comp)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "plot_composite_prioritization.pdf"),
  p_comp,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5
)
```
